items.source: If Lazy is present on a @Configuration class, this indicates that all @Bean methods within that @Configuration should be lazily initialized. If @Lazy is present and false on a @Bean method within a @Lazy-annotated @Configuration class, this indicates overriding the 'default lazy' behavior and that the bean should be eagerly initialized.
items.translation: 如果 `@Configuration` 类上存在`Lazy`，则表明该`@Configuration` 类中的所有`@Bean` 方法都应进行延迟初始化。如果`@Lazy` 存在于`@Configuration` 类中的`@Bean` 方法上且值为`false`，则表明覆盖了“默认延迟”行为，该 Bean 应被急切初始化。

items.source: If this annotation is not present on a @Component or @Bean definition, eager initialization will occur. If present and set to true, the @Bean or @Component will not be initialized until referenced by another bean or explicitly retrieved from the enclosing BeanFactory. If present and set to false, the bean will be instantiated on startup by bean factories that perform eager initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 如果该注解未出现在 `@Component` 或 `@Bean` 定义上，则会发生急切初始化。如果存在且设置为 `true`，则 `@Bean` 或 `@Component` 将在被另一个 bean 引用或从包围的 BeanFactory 显式检索之前不会被初始化。如果存在且设置为 `false`，则执行单例急切初始化的 bean 工厂将在启动时实例化该 bean。

items.source: In addition to its role for component initialization, this annotation may also be placed on injection points marked with Autowired or Inject: In that context, it leads to the creation of a lazy-resolution proxy for the affected dependency, caching it on first access in case of a singleton or re-resolving it on every access otherwise. This is an alternative to using ObjectFactory or Provider. Please note that such a lazy-resolution proxy will always be injected; if the target dependency does not exist, you will only be able to find out through an exception on invocation. As a consequence, such an injection point results in unintuitive behavior for optional dependencies. For a programmatic equivalent, allowing for lazy references with more sophistication, consider ObjectProvider.
items.translation: 除了用于组件初始化之外，此注解还可以放置在带有Autowired或Inject的注入点上：在此上下文中，它会为受影响的依赖创建延迟解析代理，在单例情况下于首次访问时缓存该代理，否则每次访问时重新解析。这是使用ObjectFactory或Provider的替代方案。请注意，此类延迟解析代理将始终被注入；如果目标依赖不存在，您只能通过调用时抛出异常来发现这一点。因此，此类注入点会导致可选依赖的行为不符合直觉。对于程序化等效实现，允许更复杂的延迟引用，请考虑使用ObjectProvider。

items.source: May be used on any class directly or indirectly annotated with @Component or on methods annotated with @Bean.
items.translation: 可用于直接或间接带有 @Component 注解的任何类，或带有 @Bean 注解的方法。
